issues.on_page: GF 2600 Operation and Maintenance of Buildings and Sites 339,060; p8 Adjustments column eliminates (36,000) of it; p9 Adjustments column Transfers In (101,000) = Depreciation 86,000 + Activities 15,000
issues.issue: Hidden transfer: 36,000 of this GF spending line is the General Fund's transfer to the Depreciation Fund (recorded as 'Transfers from General Fund' 86,000 in detail[52]). The same money is counted as both spending and a transfer. Should be split (split_from + review) into 303,060 expenditure and a -36,000 'other financing' item.

issues.on_page: GF 2650 Vehicle Acquisition and Maintenance 50,000; p8 Adjustments column (50,000), total column 0
issues.issue: Hidden transfer: the whole 50,000 is the rest of the 86,000 GF transfer to the Depreciation Fund (36,000 + 50,000 = 86,000 = Depreciation 'Transfers from General Fund', p15). Recorded as spending while detail[52] also records it as a transfer in. Should be an 'other financing' item of -50,000 (split_from + review), with 0 expenditure.

issues.on_page: Schedule of Receipts, Disbursements, Transfers and Fund Balance - Activities Fund (p20-21): about 60 activity accounts, receipts 256,456, disbursements 250,296, transfers in (out) 15,000
issues.issue: Schedule left out. The extractor kept the 2-line Activities Fund budget schedule (p18) to avoid double counting, but the no-double-counting rule says to keep the MORE detailed schedule, and the per-account schedule is far more detailed. Totals agree, so no money is missing, but the account-level detail is not recorded.
The line is printed under State Sources, so intergovernmental/state aid (detail 'other state aid') fits; 'other' is a last resort. Actual amount is 0, so no dollar impact.

issues.on_page: p7 GF column Property Tax Credit 1,112,803 / Other State Receipts 430,345; p12 GF schedule Property Tax Credit 1,122,803 (other state lines total 420,345)
issues.issue: The report itself has an offsetting 10,000 classification difference between the fund statement and the GF budget schedule (totals agree). It is only mentioned in notes, with no report_discrepancies entry. detail[12] uses the schedule figure 1,122,803.

issues.on_page: Other 253,009 (= Activities Fund 1790 Other Activity Income, p18)
issues.issue: Printed label is 'Other'. The source is identified (student activity receipts), so this category is defensible, but it is a judgment call.
Most of the line (250,296) is Activities Fund spending, so 'student activities' is the dominant category. Mixed line.
Principal and interest aren't split anywhere in the report. Recording it all as principal is an assumption (detail[69] does the same).
The function code is 4700 (facilities/capital), so 'capital outlay' may fit better. The statement folds it into Operation and Maintenance.
